title: How 19 humanoid robots performed live on stage with 120 dancers

19 Unitree robots on stage with 120 professional dancers at WorldSkills Shanghai
What it takes for humanoid robots to keep pace with 120 professional performers
caption:
At WorldSkills Shanghai 2026, 19 full-size humanoid robots performed live on stage alongside 120 professional dancers.

Unitree called it the world's largest-scale full-size humanoid robot real-time performance. The robots moved in sync with the music and the human performers, live in front of a crowd, not looping on a screen.

Two years ago, a single humanoid robot walking in a straight line was news. Now there are 19 of them dancing.
